summary: Sample separate frames from a remote clip through an aggregate byte-capped Range-only view. Geometry in, N pictures plus a closed transport receipt out.

parity.note: The decoder receives the origin's original compressed bytes and media.frames' exact one-pass implementation. tests/test_op_media_range.py compares every landed PNG against media.frames over the full local object. If the exact one-pass cannot answer every position, the arm fails closed: the historical N-process fallback could outlive the receipt deadline, and approximate pixels are forbidden. The required closed receipt proves origin_bytes < object_bytes and counts whole origin attempts. Range refusal never falls back to a whole GET. Positions and cell geometry are identical to media.frames and carry no rule for choosing one frame over another.

positions.description: Fractions of the clip's own measured duration, one per bound output address.

max_origin_bytes.description: One aggregate ceiling for discovery, probe and decode, always clamped below Content-Length.
